thesis: The episode discusses a geoengineering project in Arctic Siberia where scientists aim to resurrect an ice-age grassland biome by introducing lab-grown woolly mammoths to knock down trees and maintain permafrost. This initiative is presented as a climate change mitigation strategy intended to prevent the release of vast amounts of carbon stored in organic matter beneath the melting permafrost.
